desc:
⚔️ Every hit = +1 Strength! Upgrade your sword, smash through zombie stages and bosses, and become the strongest Sword Warrior!
🎁 CODES: WORLD4 (NEW!), WORLD3, SWORD – group members also get WARRIOR! Redeem in ⚙️ Settings → Codes.

🌍 4 worlds, 200 stages: Green Meadow, Spirit Realm, Shipwreck Bay, Frozen Peaks
🖱️ Click to gain +1 Strength!
⚔️ 48 swords, each stronger than the last!
👹 Defeat giant zombie bosses!
🏆 Earn Wins and climb the leaderboards!
🥚 Hatch buddies for powerful boosts!
🔄 Rebirth to become even stronger!
📅 Daily rewards – Day 7 is OP!
👥 Play with friends for +10% Strength each!
⭐ Favorite + join the group: +10% Strength forever!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates!
